niche.habitat: Mid-water column of the terminator ring ocean, drifting on vertical convection cells.
niche.diet: Phosphorus-rich microbial aggregates, flare-fallen nitrate particulates, anoxic brine seep-plumes.
niche.active: Diurnal pulse-feeding; rests during strong wind shear, bursts near vents.

body: Gelatinous filter-sack with trailing ciliated tentacles, hyper-renal gills, bioluminescent lure nodes.

chains.trait: Ciliated filter basket expands on nutrient pulse

skill.effect: The creature filters nutrients to restore its own vitality and strongly strengthens nearby allies, though its power fades in barren, ash-scarred waters.

chains.weakness: Starves in regions without recent volcanic ash or flare fallout.
observe: Cloud of ash/dust settling on water

journal.en: It eats the sky's ash when it rains salt.

chains.trait: Hyper-renal salt glands pump concentrated brine
links: Basin is evaporating with single outflow

skill.effect: It forcefully expels concentrated brine at nearby foes, leaving them parched and weakened by the sudden salt spray.

Water around Salinera turning milky and hypersaline

journal.en: It sweats brine to survive the drying sea.

plausibility.summary: Loom mean ~6% salinity (F17) exceeds marine teleost/osmoregulator comfort without active salt export. Chloride cells in gill epithelium and nasal/salt glands in seabirds/sharks excrete concentrated NaCl brine; excreting ~12% brine is consistent with an evaporating basin inhabitant. Milky plumes and dehydration poke damage are honest osmotic weapons. Freshwater shock weakness matches hyperosmotic specialists.
fixes: Loom mean ~6% salinity (F17) exceeds marine teleost/osmoregulator comfort without active salt export. Chloride cells in gill epithelium and nasal/salt glands in seabirds/sharks excrete concentrated NaCl brine; excreting ~12% brine is consistent with an evaporating basin inhabitant. Milky plumes and dehydration poke damage are honest osmotic weapons. Freshwater shock weakness matches hyperosmotic specialists.

body_plan.origin: Modified ascidian-like filter feeder adapted to pelagic drift in high salinity.

temperament: Docile, reactive, gregarious in nutrient patches.
secrets: Salinera tissue, when dried, can store phosphorus for weeks; player can craft 'Nutrient Paste'.
moments: A Salinera drifts past a flare-induced nitrate rain, its basket swelling until it glows like a captured star, then dissolves the light into flesh.

journal.en: The Loom Sea is not water; it is salt memory.
